edges.subject: CLN5
edges.quote: CLN5 deficiency causes a subtype of NCL, referred to as CLN5 disease.

edges.subject: CLN5 disease
edges.quote: We found that the basal level of LC3-II was elevated in both CLN5 disease patient fibroblasts and CLN5-deficient HeLa cells.

edges.subject: CLN5 disease
edges.quote: Further analysis using tandem fluorescent mRFP-GFP-LC3 showed the autophagy flux was increased.

edges.subject: SNCA
edges.quote: We found the alpha-synuclein (α-syn) gene SNCA was highly up-regulated in CLN5 disease patient fibroblasts.

edges.subject: CLN5 deficiency
edges.quote: Intriguingly, knocking down SNCA reversed lysosomal perinuclear clustering caused by CLN5 deficiency.

edges.subject: SNCA
edges.quote: These results suggest α-syn may affect lysosomal clustering in non-neuronal cells, similar to its role in presynaptic vesicles in neurons.

edges.subject: alpha-synuclein
edges.quote: Furthermore, α-syn was localized to the vicinity of lysosomes in CLN5 deficient cells, indicating it may have a lysosome-related function.
